# The Satyr Arcana — DJ Green Satyr

> The Satyr Arcana is an 81-card tarot reimagined as music by DJ Green Satyr, a Phoenix, Arizona electronic music artist with 30 years of electronic music. Every card is a real person, an original track and an original portrait. Satyr Arcana I (15 tracks) and Satyr Arcana Part 2 (17 tracks, October 31, 2026) are on Bandcamp.

## Start here
- [Which card claims you? Free 12-question quiz](https://greensatyr.buzz/)
- [Music catalog](https://greensatyr.buzz/music/)
- [Satyr Arcana I on Bandcamp](https://djgreensatyr.bandcamp.com/album/satyr-arcana-i)
- [Satyr Arcana Part 2 on Bandcamp](https://djgreensatyr.bandcamp.com/album/satyr-arcana-part-2)

## Also from the same creator
- [Cursed Worlds](https://greensatyr.buzz/cursed-worlds/): dark fantasy and horror books
- [Film](https://greensatyr.buzz/film/): screen work including Lyvia's House
